Block.Name: FCN_GRP_CAN_PRIV
Block.WhereClause:
USER_ID!=:ctrl_block.user_id and mnemonic
=:user_menu.mnemonic and
user_id in (select user_id from system_users where
user_last_name is not null and user_first_name is not null and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))
Block.QueryDataSourceName:
select 
 fgp.user_id user_id,fgp.grp_id grp_id, fgp.acc_priv acc_priv,mi.mnemonic mnemonic
from
 menu_item mi ,
 menu_item mmi ,
 fcn ,
 fcn_grp_priv fgp
where fcn.fcn_id = mi.fcn_id and
 fcn.appl_id = mi.appl_id and
 mmi.appl_id (+) = mi.appl_id and
 mmi.fcn_id (+) = mi.menu_id and
 fgp.appl_id = mi.appl_id and
 nvl(substr(mi.acc_lvl,
 to_number(substr(fgp.grp_id,4,2))+1,
 1),'9') <= to_char(fgp.acc_priv) and
 substr(mi.acc_lvl,
 to_number(substr(fgp.grp_id,4,2))+1,1) not in ('0',' ') 
 and
 nvl(mi.item_hide,'N') !='Y' and
 to_char(fgp.acc_priv) >=
 (select nvl(max(to_number(nvl(decode(
 substr(pi.acc_lvl, to_number(substr(fgp.grp_id,4,2))+1,1),
 ' ','10','0','10'),
 substr(pi.acc_lvl, to_number(substr(fgp.grp_id,4,2))+1,1)))),'10')
 from menu_item pi
 where pi.appl_id = mi.appl_id
 connect by pi.fcn_id = prior menu_id
 start with pi.mnemonic = mmi.mnemonic)

DECLARE

 l_print_id VARCHAR2(40);
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
